method: Each finding from evidence/react-doctor-evaluation.json was read against its source and classified. A false positive claims a defect the code does not have.

findings.rationale: useState(shell.getTheme()) evaluates getTheme() on every render and discards the result after the first; useState(() => shell.getTheme()) avoids it. The cost is small because getTheme reads shared state.

The iframe hosts the cross-origin legacy servicing portal, so the same-origin policy already prevents the full access the message claims. A sandbox attribute is still a valid hardening step, but it must be checked against the legacy bridge's postMessage use before it is added.
The Vite application exports trackOrderSelected, a non-component function, from a component file, so Fast Refresh reloads the module and loses component state.
